name: cc-quota-guard
description: Quota-aware Claude Code: stop at a clean checkpoint before you hit your usage limit, and optionally auto-revert an in-progress todo item if you blow through a hard threshold.

session_soft.title: Soft threshold — 5-hour session (%)
session_soft.description: At this usage %, Claude finishes the current todo item, then stops cleanly (commits, writes progress notes).

session_hard.title: Hard threshold — 5-hour session (%)
session_hard.description: At this usage %, Claude can be stopped mid-item. With auto-revert off (default) this just forces a clean stop; with it on, the in-progress item is reverted with git stash.

weekly_hard.title: Hard threshold — weekly (%)
weekly_hard.description: Same as the session hard threshold, but for the 7-day weekly quota.

hard_abort_enabled.title: Enable auto-revert (git stash) on the hard threshold
hard_abort_enabled.description: Off by default. When on, a hard threshold hit mid-item automatically reverts that item's changes with git stash and redoes it after the quota resets. Read the README's Safety section before enabling this.
